tip_title: Your Dwelling Limit Covers Up to a Number. But What If Rebuilding Costs More?
topic: Home Insurance - Guaranteed Replacement Cost Endorsement
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: Your Dwelling Limit Covers Up to a Number. But What If Rebuilding Costs More?**

Standard homeowners policies pay up to your dwelling coverage limit to rebuild your house after a total loss. That sounds fine until you realize construction costs have climbed sharply over the last few years and the number you set two or three years ago might not cover what it costs to rebuild the same house today. There's an endorsement worth knowing about called guaranteed replacement cost coverage, and it does exactly what the name says: pays whatever it actually costs to rebuild, even if that number exceeds your policy limit. Not every insurer offers it, and it does cost more, but for a household with a home they'd want fully rebuilt, it's a conversation worth having.

Curious whether your current dwelling limit is in the right ballpark or whether this endorsement makes sense for your home? Your Peachy agent can run through it with you.

tip_title: If Winter Weather Damages Your Home, What You Do in the First 24 Hours Matters More Than You'd Think.
topic: Home Insurance - Winter Storm Claims Documentation
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: If Winter Weather Damages Your Home, What You Do in the First 24 Hours Matters More Than You'd Think.**

Most people know their homeowners policy covers winter storm damage — burst pipes, collapsed gutters from ice weight, interior damage from a sudden freeze. What most people don't think about is that how you document that damage in the immediate aftermath has a real impact on how the claim goes. Specifically: photo everything before you clean it up, keep receipts for any emergency repairs you make to prevent further damage (your policy may reimburse those), and call your insurer before you let a contractor start work. Waiting too long or skipping the documentation step can turn a covered loss into a disputed one. November is a good time to know this before you actually need it.

If you've never walked through what your policy actually requires you to do after a loss, your Peachy agent can go through it with you now, before anything happens.

📖 [Learn more from Insurance.com](https://www.insurance.com/home-and-renters-insurance/natural-disasters/property-coverage.html)

tip_title: Thanksgiving Travel Is Two Weeks Out. One Auto Coverage Check Worth Making Now.
topic: Auto Insurance - Holiday Travel and Liability Exposure
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: Thanksgiving Travel Is Two Weeks Out. One Auto Coverage Check Worth Making Now.**

November is one of the highest-traffic months on the road, and more cars moving means more chances for a serious at-fault accident. The thing most people don't think about until it's too late is whether their bodily injury liability limits are actually high enough to cover a bad one. If you cause an accident that injures multiple people and your per-occurrence limit is on the lower end, the gap between what your policy pays and what a lawsuit demands comes out of your pocket. Pull up your declarations page and look at your liability limits before the holiday weekend hits.

Not sure if your limits make sense for where you are financially right now? Your Peachy agent can walk through it with you in about ten minutes.

📖 [Learn more from NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/insurance/homeowners/learn/dwelling-coverage-homeowners)
